repo_irregularities.issue: Property named "grains_per_troy_ounce": 31.1034768 mislabels grams per troy ounce (31.1034768 g/ozt) as grains per troy ounce (1 ozt = 480 grains per NIST Handbook 130 § 2.17).
repo_irregularities.resolution: Add canonical "grams_per_troy_ounce": 31.1034768 and "true_grains_per_troy_ounce": 480 (retaining legacy alias only with explicit deprecation note if external tools read it, while updating build.mjs and verify.mjs to prefer grams_per_troy_ounce).

repo_irregularities.issue: Flag ID F15 is skipped, F30 erroneously states "No price for [Aurate] is recorded anywhere in this dataset" despite 5 Aurate rows in data/rings.json, and F32 claims Ross-Simons Gold Weight "is usually there" on the unread 13 rows whereas 0 of 10 stone-set/estate rows publish Gold Weight.
repo_irregularities.resolution: Update F30 and F32 with verified facts while preserving original_id provenance, and document the F15 numbering gap.
